Each entry names a cause as well as a title: `match` is a regex tested against the first line of the
failure's message (ANSI stripped, the reporter's `Error: ` prefix removed), and an entry that cannot
pin one says `"flaky": true` instead. That field is not a mute button — it is the declared statement
that the failure text was never captured, or has been seen to vary, so only the title is known. A
title whose cause was observed gets a `match` built from it, unioned across every shape observed, and
a genuinely new cause then reads as unexpected. `local/lib/known-red.mjs` is the one matcher that
enforces this, and `local/check-e2e-known-failure-titles.mjs` reports an entry with neither field as a
